text:
alex: Preflight heads-up — planning to cut v0.12.0 in ~2h (14:00 PT). There are 3 PRs blocking the cut:
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4023 (model-routing: needs changelog entry)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4031 (kv-cache: flaky test failing, needs review)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4038 (backports: cherry-pick to release branch)
Can someone take ownership of tagging/backports + quick LGTM? :pray:

maria: I can take PR4023 and write a changelog blurb. Will push in 20m.

jordan: I'll look at PR4031 now — seeing a test flake in CI logs.

sam: pinging @eng-sre for backport assistance on PR4038 — that cherry-pick touches infra config.

lee: (saw flake) that test is timing-sensitive on slower runners. Quick hack: increase timeout from 500ms to 800ms in test, but @jordan maybe prefer rerun on same commit? Thoughts.

jordan: I'll try rerun CI first, if it fails again I'll apply the timeout and mention in PR.

release-bot: Reminder: release window opens 2025-06-11T21:00:00Z. Please ensure PRs have 'release/ready' label and changelog entries.

alex: Update: maria pushed changelog + small formatting fix. PR4023 now has label release/ready.

maria: added entry: "runtime: model routing fix reduces tail latency for short sequences" — short and QA'd.

sam: backport queued for PR4038, tagging @eng-sre for review, created branch release/0.12-backports/4038.

jordan: rerun passed. left one nits comment, but nothing blocking. LGTM when tests green. :thumbsup:

alex: Awesome. If everyone confirms by +1 we'll cut on schedule. If any blockers, shout now so we can delay.

lee: +1

maria: +1

jordan: +1

sam: +1 — merging backport once SRE approves.

alex: Great — I'll start the cut at T-10 and post progress here. Thanks all. :rocket:
